references.label: MONGER spinner lanes
references.description: The left orbit, center lane, and right orbit contain spinners that spell MONGER; the center spinner or a completed orbit raises Iron Monger during multiball.

references.label: Iron Monger toy
references.description: Central rising target used to qualify and score Iron Monger Multiball.

references.label: Monger Super lane
references.description: Center shot used for the Iron Monger Super Jackpot and Do or Die.

references.label: IRON MAN targets
references.description: Seven red standups that qualify Fast Scoring, Double Scoring, and Iron Man Scoring according to adjustments.

references.label: War Machine shot
references.description: Right-side kicker that starts and scores War Machine Multiball.

references.label: Whiplash targets
references.description: Two standup targets beside the magnet that qualify Whiplash Multiball.
